title: Detection of Anti-Phytopathogenic Fungal Activity
author: Cecilia Monica Rodriguez García
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.wyqffvw

steps.title: Prepare AE dilutions
steps.instruction: From the 10 % aqueous extract (AE) prepare three serial dilutions by mixing AE with sterile water; do not add conidial suspension (CS) at this stage.

steps.title: Set up reaction tubes
steps.instruction: In sterile 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes add 125 µL of each AE dilution (including the undiluted 10 % AE) or control solution, in duplicate; then add 12.5 µL of the conidial suspension (200 conidia/µL) to each tube.

substeps.instruction: Positive control: add 1 µL commercial fungicide to 125 µL sterile water, then 12.5 µL CS (duplicate).
Negative control 1: add 125 µL sterile water, then 12.5 µL CS (duplicate).
Negative control 2: add 125 µL PDB, then 12.5 µL CS (duplicate).

steps.title: Incubate tubes
steps.instruction: Seal the tubes, homogenize thoroughly, and incubate in the dark at 26‑28 °C for 3 days.

steps.title: Transfer to PDA plates
steps.instruction: After 3 days, vortex each tube to ensure homogeneity and transfer 25 µL of the suspension onto the centre of a PDA plate (polystyrene dish, Corning), in duplicate.

steps.title: Incubate PDA plates
steps.instruction: Incubate the PDA plates at 26 ± 2 °C under a 12 h light/12 h dark photoperiod for 7 days.

steps.title: Evaluate fungal growth
steps.instruction: On day 7 assess each plate: absence of fungal growth indicates fungicidal activity of the extract; visible growth indicates no fungicidal effect.
